lean.statement:
(W : E → ℝ) (hW : ContDiff ℝ 2 W)
    (hI : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W x))) (hZ : 0 < ∫ x, Real.exp (-W x))
    (m : ℝ) (hl : ∀ x a, m * ‖a‖^2 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ W) x a a)
    (μ : Measure E) (hμ : μ = (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -W x))
    (D : Lp ℝ 2 μ →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 μ)
    (hD : D.IsClosable)
    (hgraph : ∀ a H, (a,H) ∈ D.graph ↔
      ∃ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport ψ ∧
        a =ᵐ[μ] ψ ∧ H =ᵐ[μ] gradient ψ)
    (v F : E → ℝ) (G : E → E) (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hv : tsupport v ⊆ K) (hF : tsupport F ⊆ K) (hG : tsupport G ⊆ K)
    (hv2 : MemLp v 2 volume) (hF2 : MemLp F 2 volume) (hG2 : MemLp G 2 volume)
    (hd : ∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ a : E,
      Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (G x) a) volume ∧
      Integrable (fun x => v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a) volume ∧
      (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (G x) a) = -∫ x, v x * fderiv ℝ ψ x a)
    (hweak : ∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ →
      Integrable (fun x => v x * Laplacian.laplacian ψ x) volume ∧
      Integrable (fun x => F x * ψ x) volume ∧
      (∫ x, v x * Laplacian.laplacian ψ x) = ∫ x, F x * ψ x) :
    let A := fun x => inner ℝ (gradient W x) (G x)-F x
    MemLp v 2 μ ∧ MemLp G 2 μ ∧ MemLp A 2 μ ∧
    ∃ vW AW : Lp ℝ 2 μ, ∃ GW : Lp E 2 μ,
      vW =ᵐ[μ] v ∧ AW =ᵐ[μ] A ∧ GW =ᵐ[μ] G ∧
      (vW,GW) ∈ D.closure.graph ∧ m * ‖GW‖^2 ≤ ‖AW‖^2
approved_definition_context: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel E with canonical ordinary volume, including dimension0. All instances are part of the signature; NNReal are nonnegative reals.

Measure.tilted(-W) is the actual exp(-W)/integral(exp(-W)) Gibbs measure; actual integrability and positive partition are hypotheses in the generic producer and derived in the source consumer. The given mu law equality is structural, not a final domain or inequality certificate.

MemLp f2mu is actual AE strong measurability and finite L2 norm; toLp is its true AE quotient. Returned vW/AW/GW are actual L2 classes with three explicit AE links. Norms are actual weighted L2 norms; graph is the original real-linear partial gradient graph and IsClosable/closure are genuine Mathlib APIs.

Generic ordinary data v,F,G have same compact topological support, actual volumeL2 and allC1/allC2 weak equations with both legal L1 products. The desired weighted L2/convergence/domain/coercivity is produced, not a premise. m is any real number with actual lower quadratic-form bound.

Generic exact hgraph characterizes original smooth compact functions/gradients; sameD.closure graph membership is an output. No rough classical gradient/Hessian, generator-adjoint/core equality or global tail theorem is claimed.

Source actual J is Gaussian augmentation, R/S actual Markov/disintegrating kernels; S_y is reflected(2x-y)#R_y, true W_y=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), alpha/beta/eta constants exact. OriginalD precedes epsilon/f, ONEu precedes allC2 compact cutoffs; no jointly measurable selector is produced.

Source v=chi*u, Gchi=chi*D.closureu+u*gradientchi, Fchi=chi*(epsilon*u+innergradW,D.closureu-f)+2innergradchi,D.closureu+u*Deltachi. Achi=innergradW,Gchi-Fchi, with exact sign. Returned closure membership and ((alpha+eta^-1)/4)*normGW^2<=normAW^2 use actual S_y.

Compact weighted scalar prerequisite does not establish cutoff removal/global Bochner, adjoint/core, epsilon0/kernel/range/Poincare/BL or complete main/composition. TV proximity never transfers unbounded expected cost.
